D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Kristen McDonald Rivet leads by 19.5 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 74,235 votes; a one point swing is about 1,905 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +10.5 and D +28.1. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$4.3M cash against $183K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
Air cover: Outside groups spent $412K helping Thomas J. Smith and $293K helping Kristen McDonald Rivet.

R.t: Thomas J. Smith trails by 19.5 and wins 0% of simulations. Closing it takes about 37,118 voters switching sides, or 74,235 more net votes from new turnout.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +28.1 and D +10.5. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
